summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 8.1 to Angular 9.1 using `ng update`, which applied the core v9 migrations (static query flag, @Injectable, ModuleWithProviders generic, Renderer2, undecorated classes) and the CLI workspace migration to angular.json and the tsconfig files. @angular-devkit/build-angular was moved to 0.901.x and @ngrx/* to 9.2.1 so the toolchain and the NgRx libraries match Angular 9. install and build pass from a clean node_modules; tests still fail exactly as they did at baseline, for the same pre-existing reason.
changes: ng update @angular/core@9 @angular/cli@9 applied all six Angular v9 code migrations (no source changes were required by them).

CLI workspace migration added "aot": true and an anyComponentStyle budget to angular.json, rewrote src/tsconfig.app.json and src/tsconfig.server.json to the files/include form, and added the renderModule/renderModuleFactory re-export to src/main.ts.
Bumped @angular-devkit/build-angular to ~0.901.15 to match CLI 9 (ng update left it on 0.801.0).
Ran ng update for @ngrx/* to 9.2.1, which executed the NgRx "road to v9" migrations for effects and router-store.
package-lock.json regenerated through npm; verified by deleting node_modules and running a clean npm install followed by npm run build.
manual_followups: `npm run test` still fails, as it did at baseline. The cause is unrelated to the upgrade: angular.json's test target lists "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so webpack cannot resolve the stylesheet and karma never runs a spec. Left untouched to keep this hop to the upgrade; worth fixing on its own.

`npm run build:ssr` fails with "TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'minimatch'". src/tsconfig.server.json inherits typeRoots: [node_modules/@types] with no "types" restriction, and the hoisted @types/minimatch@6 is a stub with no .d.ts. Pre-existing shape of the config, not covered by the hop's required checks; adding an explicit "types" list to the server tsconfig would resolve it.

@nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader is still pinned at 7.1.0 and has an unsatisfied peer on @angular/platform-server ^7.1.4. It is deprecated from Angular 9 onward (Ivy makes it unnecessary); plan to drop ModuleMapLoaderModule from app.server.module.ts in a later hop.
Ivy is now the default compiler for this app. A runtime smoke test of the CRUD screens is worth doing, since the build only proves compilation.
